outcome.technical: (1) THE FLIP-ROW FAULT REPRODUCED. On HEAD code, cf5 (the journal hook as a process for both passes, rows read back from the trail) wrote no row for any of five writes that switch the journal off: a config created off by a command, by an MCP tool and by an edit tool, and an existing config flipped on->off by a command and by an edit tool (`python3 -B tests/test_journal_writes.py --selftest` before the fix: FAIL cf5 with rows [] for all five, exit codes [0, 0]). The refusal lives in _journal_io._append (`if not enabled(config): raise IOError("journal disabled ...")`), which the hook's _append_rows called with the config loaded from disk after the call. _journal_io.py is NOT changed: the Post pass now marks the row it owes because the switch was on before the call with a private entry key `_ON_BEFORE` (journal-writes.py, set in _swept_tree when the current switch is off, and on the edit lane only for a row whose target is CONFIG_REL); _append_rows pops that key and, only when the row goes into the project's own trail (_config._same_dir(troot, project)), hands append the loaded config with journal.enabled True. No other caller of append is touched; the key never reaches a row (_normalise builds the row from known fields, and post_entries strips it too). The slot is refreshed after the last will so the writer's next call does not owe it again (cq6). (2) ABSENT. `ABSENT = "absent"` is the slot's `sha256` value for a file that does not exist: _snapshot returns (ABSENT, None) on FileNotFoundError/NotADirectoryError and keeps (None, None) for any other OSError (unreadable). "No pass before" is no slot at all (_read_preimage returns None), told apart in _swept_tree: `pre is None` -> seed a present file, claim nothing (as before); `pre.sha256 == ABSENT` and the file present -> creation. cq3 shows both in one case: the same write with no Pre leaves [] and with a Pre leaves the creation row. A phase file's name is unknown before it exists, so the Pre pass keeps the shard directory's listing in a slot named `<shard dir>/` (_note_listing, written only when it changed; the listing is the one _swept_targets already made, now returned by the new _sweep_paths), and _absent_by_listing turns 'not in the noted listing' into an ABSENT note. (3) CREATION ROW: same keys as an edit row; no key added. Wording: summary `<tool> created <rel>` (_created_rows); a config created switched off appends `: journal.enabled true->false` with details.changes [the flip from the default]; a plan file gets details.reason CREATED_NOT_DERIVED and the same text in the summary, and no chained rows. The edit lane's rows keep their wording (`Write wrote ...`) byte for byte; the edit lane now also judges a created config's switch from the default, so a config an edit tool creates switched off leaves its flip row. verify/drift_anchor/newest_anchor read a creation row as an edit row: cc1 (test__journal_io) - creation row, verify ([], []), then an edit behind the journal warns exactly once naming .claude/audit.config.json. (4) Dedupe: an edit tool creating the config leaves exactly one row (cf6); a creation goes through the same recorded_states window check, so a verb's own row for the state is not repeated (cq4). (5) Orchestrator probes, copies under <SP>/sg1.47 (fixtures repointed there): probe_sh AFTER - real/linked x absent/plain/dest now each `[('config.edit', '.claude/audit.config.json')]` where BEFORE had [] (3 rows changed), every present row unchanged; probe_j - u20b changed DIS->ok (one config row), every other row's cfgrows identical to sg1.46-mine/probe_j.after.out; u21 STAYS DIS: it is an MCP write of a SIBLING linked worktree's config from a session standing in the project, and <SP>/sg1.47/w/probe_u21p.py shows no row before or after the change with that config ABSENT or PRESENT - the sweep does not read that tree's paths at all, which is the excluded 'another tree's config through an MCP tool' and would need the swept tree set widened; the documents now name it. twins.py WRONG: 0; probe_e identical to sg1.46-mine/probe_e.after.out (no warning, no finding); probe_a differing: 0 of 1960. (6) Mutation probe <SP>/sg1.47/mutations.py (output mutations.out), run from the worktree root on a copy: 11 rows, MUTATIONS ALL CAUGHT, exit 0 - absence snapshots as unreadable -> cf1 cf2 cf3 cf5 cq3 cc1; Pre does not note absence -> cf1 cf2 cf3 cf5 cq3; shard listing never kept -> cf4; created-off row withheld sweep lane -> cf5, edit lane -> cf5 cq6; flip row withheld (append handed the after config) -> cf5; last will twice, sweep lane slot -> cq6, edit lane slot -> cq6; ALLOW a row whenever the file is present after -> cq3 cq5 (also f10b f11 f5 f8 s1); ALLOW last will marked for any config row -> cq7; ALLOW creation written despite a verb's row -> cq4. (7) Runs, each exit 0 unless said: task gate `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --jobs 4 tests/test_journal_writes.py tests/test__journal_io.py` 2/2 files, 466 cases (184 + 282); dependants 7 suites 2319 cases: test_journal_writes 183, test__journal_io 282, test_audit_journal 186, test_hooks 247, test__config 413, test_drive_phase 1008, test_guard_edits FAILED once on cf32c only ('the disk image is detached again') - a file outside my scope, re-run alone 126/126; `python3 tools/bench-hooks.py --gate` exit 0 (3.14.7 only, other interpreters not measured); test__deps/test__output_lints/test__refs 3/3 files 792 cases; gate-parity.py 0; prove-gates.py --list 0; ruff and vermin clean on the changed .py files; run-test-gate.py SG1 --task SG1.47-ukq unrecorded: exit 0, 'GATE GREEN' (its affected/related suites included; tallies clipped by the tool without --verbose).
